responsibility: This file implements GCC’s emission of VMS Debug-format symbol and source-correlation information. When VMS debugging is enabled, it tracks source files and line tables, records function and block boundaries, writes module, routine, line, and source-correlation DST records into the .vmsdebug section, and gathers VMS-specific file metadata such as creation date, size, format, and version. Its responsibility is object-file debug record generation for the VMS native debug format, distinct from DWARF, stabs, or XCOFF back ends.
